hooks.command: if [ -n "$OBSIDIAN_AUTH_TOKEN" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.obsidian-headless" && printf "%s" "$OBSIDIAN_AUTH_TOKEN" > "$HOME/.obsidian-headless/auth_token" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.obsidian-headless/auth_token"; fi; if [ -n "$CLIP_LINK_COOKIES_B64" ]; then mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/clip-link" && printf "%s" "$CLIP_LINK_COOKIES_B64" | base64 -d > "$HOME/.config/clip-link/cookies.txt" && chmod 600 "$HOME/.config/clip-link/cookies.txt"; fi; exit 0
